semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The company acts as an agent for advanced semiconductor processing equipment and materials, supporting semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Pacific Change Inc. operates as a professional agent for advanced semiconductor processing equipment and related materials, primarily sourced from Europe, America, and Japan. The company supports domestic semiconductor manufacturing by providing front-end equipment and spare parts, as well as solar cell manufacturing equipment.
capabilities: Agent for advanced semiconductor processing equipment
Supplier of semiconductor manufacturing front-end equipment and spare parts
Provider of solar cell manufacturing equipment and spare parts
Distributor of CNC spare parts and automated instruments

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Shanghai and focuses on supporting domestic customers in China.
